marketed_by: Meril Life Sciences India Pvt. Ltd.
tagline: Clean Hands, Prepped Skin - The Perfect Start To Infection Prevention
description: MIREX Alcohol Rub is a ready-to-use, alcohol-based hand rub designed for rapid disinfection without the need for water or a wash basin. It plays a vital role in infection prevention across various healthcare and industrial settings where hand hygiene is essential.

technical_specifications.formulation: Ready-to-use, no dilution or water required
product_properties: Excellent skin tolerability even with long term use

directions_for_use: Hygienic Hand Disinfection: Apply 3 ml of MIREX Alcohol Rub onto clean, dry hands and nail grooves. Rub thoroughly for 30 sec
Surgical Hand Disinfection: Apply 6 ml of MIREX Alcohol Rub onto clean, dry hands, nail grooves, and up to the elbow. Rub thoroughly for 1.5 minutes
areas_of_application: Critical care areas: ICU, ICCU, NICU, MICU, AKD
Departments managing infectious diseases and burn care
Home care settings and home dialysis

product_properties: Excellent skin tolerability even with long term use
Ready-to-use, no water or wash basin required
Effective for both hygienic and surgical hand disinfection

ideal_for: Critical care and operation theatre hand hygiene
Infectious disease and burn care departments
Emergency medical services and home care
key_strengths: Broad virucidal coverage including HBV, HCV and HIV
30 second hygienic and 1.5 minute surgical protocols
Skin tolerable with glycerin emollient for long term use
Four pack formats from 100 ml to 5 L
